title: Apply acceptance, label, kind and other planning-field edits in incremental task-folder imports
outcome: Apply acceptance, label, kind and other planning-field edits in incremental task-folder imports
acceptance: An incremental --basis import of a resolved task folder applies a changed acceptance list (added, removed and reordered criteria) to an existing task, in order, instead of refusing it as unsupported_fields; each other planning field the task document carries (acceptance_bindings, evaluation_mode, kind, labels, assigned_to, deferred_until, external_ref) is either applied the same way or refused by name with a documented reason, and the decision for each field is recorded in the git-task-sync brief

Host-local state never transfers: claims, runs, grants, completion seals and activity are untouched by an applied edit, and a field change on a task with live or historical execution is refused or reconciled under the model-A rules, not silently applied

Tests cover each applied field (with an exact replay that changes nothing) and each refused field (naming it); the S3 pilot's second Mac edit (task 3 gains a criterion) imports into the Windows replica
